quick.title: Quick answer
quick.explanation: A single agent answers the question directly.

discuss.title: Expert consult
discuss.explanation: Multiple experts analyze in parallel, then one synthesizes.

multi_solution.title: Multiple solutions
multi_solution.explanation: Multiple experts each propose a solution, then compare.

implement.title: Implement
implement.explanation: An implementer makes code changes (requires approval).

review.title: Implement then review
review.explanation: Implementer changes, then a reviewer verifies; redo on fail.

audit.title: Read-only audit
audit.explanation: Multiple experts audit the current state, then summarize risks.

answer.label: Answer
answer.prompt: Answer the user request directly. Do not modify files unless explicitly required.

consult.label: Consult
consult.prompt: Analyze the problem from your role's perspective and give your expert opinion.

synthesize.label: Synthesize
synthesize.prompt: Synthesize the experts' opinions from the previous phase into a consensus.

propose.label: Propose
propose.prompt: Independently propose a complete solution; do not reference others.

compare.label: Compare
compare.prompt: Compare the pros and cons of the proposed solutions; give a recommendation with rationale.

implement.label: Implement
implement.prompt: Make the minimal necessary changes and run validation; report root cause, changes, validation, residual risk.

verify.label: Review
verify.prompt: Check whether the previous phase meets the bar, has side effects, and is adequately validated. Output PASS if it passes, otherwise FAIL with a concrete issue list.

audit.label: Audit
audit.prompt: Audit risks and issues in the current state; output an issue list.
